source_context: Sandbox historical replay evidence pilot for Singapore electronics manufacturing movements.
evidence_items: Singapore electronics output in 2021 was supported by stronger electronics demand and semiconductor demand during the global technology cycle.
Consumer electronics demand, data center chips, and work-from-home demand supported parts of the electronics manufacturing base.
The global chip shortage and wafer demand affected electronics supply chains and production patterns during the year.
Foundry demand, logic chip demand, and memory demand contributed to strong semiconductor-related electronics activity.
